title: How to Help Your Teen Leave Group Drama Without Adding More Fuel
summary: Help your teen sort ordinary disagreement from group drama and danger, choose repair or exit, set a neutral boundary, secure accounts, escalate responsibly, and recover.
seo_title: Help Your Teen Leave Group Drama With Less Fuel
seo_description: A practical parent guide to teen group drama: sort conflict from danger, choose repair or exit, use exact scripts, protect evidence and accounts, and escalate safely.
release_move: Keep adult ownership of safety and formal escalation while returning ordinary repair-versus-exit, timing, wording, ally and recovery choices to the teenager.

hero.alt: A mother gives her teenage daughter space after she steps away from a peer group in a community-centre corridor.

social_image.alt: A mother gives her teenage daughter space after she steps away from a peer group in a community-centre corridor.

core_belief_shift.from: To protect my teen, I need to confront the group, expose the full story or control every part of the exit.
core_belief_shift.to: I can own safety and escalation while helping my teen leave ordinary drama with a neutral boundary, less amplification and growing ownership.

book_relevance.reason: The War Playbook is a restrained optional fit for reading pressure, choosing which conflicts deserve engagement, setting boundaries and protecting tomorrow from reactive choices; this guide stands alone.

next_step.reason: Optional teen practice for reading group pressure, choosing conflicts and using boundaries without retaliatory escalation.
